note: The Ember Vault dungeon now wears Dungeon Pry stone: floors, walls, and doors are hand-painted tiles instead of flat colors, barrels, bookshelves, carpets, flasks, and tables dress the galleries, and loot lying on the ground shows as a closed chest. The look is new but the dungeon plays exactly as before — same layout, monsters, and loot, and stairs, altars, and shopkeepers keep their old art. The matching open-chest frame ships with the art and will appear once a loot interaction opens chests.
